plugin.description: Runs accurate, configurable Speedtest.net checks and can keep a CSV history.
plugin.requirements: Internet access and acceptance of Ookla's CLI terms for personal, non-commercial use.

SpeedtestPlus.description: Shows the test time, ping, download and upload. Press to run manually or choose a 5, 10, 15, 30 or 60 minute schedule.

settings.action_name: Names this action and its CSV file when individual CSV files are enabled.
settings.server_id: Remember a worldwide Speedtest.net server, enter a known server ID, or use Ookla's automatic selection.
settings.csv_output: CSV saving, location, and shared-versus-individual mode are configured globally.
